about_the_game:
Note

The game is still in Early Access so the description will change as the game is developed. Please keep in mind that this does mean that some mechanics will get removed and added. Please adjust your expectations accordingly.

Euberis has stolen the crown and escaped into the labyrinth, The crown jewels are scattered across the land. Enter the labyrinths, defeat the bosses who hold the jewels, confront Euberis and return the crown to its rightful air. Take control of 5 uniquely gifted warriors to embark on a quest in this strategy roguelike with jrpg elements.

Each warrior descended from 1 of the noble tribes from the human kingdom, tasked with stopping Euberis and returning the jewel of their tribes. Jewels that grant the one who holds them immense power. With this power, the corrupt king can reshape the world and lay waste to humanity.

Gameplay

Take control of 5 uniquely gifted warriors to embark on a quest in this strategy roguelike with jrpg elements.

Terira the druid from the Nature Tribe. Digging holes around snare plants found all over the labyrinths to trap enemies and weaken them before capture.

Frostian the warrior from the Protection Tribe. Armed with a magical mace, he releases Iorn Madens upon those who oppose the throne.

Ivar is a scout from the Preminishion Tribe. His crossbow shoots faster than the eye could see and melts any rock or metal.

Chrysusias from the tribe of Gold. A mage who turns objects from gold back into what they were meant to be.

Eon is an old and wise healer from the Tribe of Immortality. Casting a bubble of healing around him any ally within his bubble's range heals all their wounds.

With 5 unique regions with countless procedurally generated labyrinths to explore use all the characters and their abilities in fun and unique ways to defeat the bosses of every region and race to collect all the jewels.

Upgrade the characters' abilities at the shopkeeper in the fortress where you can regroup after every run.

Switch between characters in real-time at any time during gameplay. Pickup horns to call upon your allies to help build your winning strategies.

  • Processor: Intel i5-750 /AMD Phenom II X4-945
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
